sn35.72:1.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudāyañ ca atthagamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ||
sn35.72:1.2: avusitaṃ tena brahmacariyam ārakā so imasmā dhammavinayāti || || 3
sn35.72:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.72:2.3: ahañhi bhante channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañ ca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti || || 4-6
sn35.72:3.2: Cakkhuṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti || ||
sn35.72:5.1: Sādhu bhikkhu || ettha ca te bhikkhu Cakkhu netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtam sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati ||
sn35.72:5.2: evan te etaṃ pathamam phassāyatanam pahīnam bhavissati āyatim apunabbhavāya || la || || 7-8
sn35.72:6.1: Jivhā netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti || ||
sn35.72:8.1: Sādhu bhikkhu || ettha ca te bhikkhu Jivhā netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭham bhavissati || evante etam catuttham phassāyatanam pahīnam bhavissati āyatim apunabbhavāya || || pa || || 9
sn35.72:9.1: Manaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti samanupassasīti || ||
sn35.72:11.1: Sādhu bhikkhu || ettha ca te bhikkhu Mano netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭham bhavissati ||
sn35.72:11.2: evam te etaṃ chaṭṭham phassāyatanam pahīnam bhavissati āyatim apunabbhavāyāti || || 2
